tips.title: Turn off Wi-Fi scanning
tips.detail: Location > Location services > Wi-Fi scanning. Stops background Wi-Fi scans used only for location.

tips.title: Turn off Bluetooth scanning
tips.detail: Location > Location services > Bluetooth scanning. Stops background BLE scans used only for location.

tips.title: Pause the work profile out of hours
tips.detail: Swipe down > Quick settings > Work apps (or schedule it). Stops its Google Play services, Outlook, Teams and Company Portal.

tips.title: Remove unused Dual Messenger clones
tips.detail: Settings > Advanced features > Dual Messenger. Each clone keeps a whole extra Android user running.

tips.title: Remove or lock Secure Folder if unused
tips.detail: Secure Folder > Settings > More settings > Uninstall. It is a full extra Android user.

tips.title: Quick Share: Contacts only
tips.detail: Settings > Connected devices > Quick Share. Reduces nearby-device discovery traffic.

tips.title: Put unused apps to sleep
tips.detail: Battery > Background usage limits > Put unused apps to sleep, and add rarely used apps to Deep sleeping.

tips.title: Reduce Wi-Fi multicast on the router
tips.detail: Enable IGMP snooping / multicast-to-unicast and a longer IPv6 Router Advertisement interval. Test one night with Wi-Fi off to confirm.

tips.title: Use Wi-Fi Calling where signal is weak
tips.detail: Phone app > Settings > Wi-Fi calling. Weak signal makes the modem work harder.

diagnostics.title: Drain since last charge
diagnostics.command: dumpsys batterystats | grep -E -m 12 'Time on battery|Screen on:|Discharge:|discharge:|Amount discharged while|Weak signal time|Connectivity changes|Total partial wakelock time|Multicast wakelock time'

diagnostics.title: Wakeup reasons
diagnostics.command: dumpsys batterystats | grep -E '^  Wakeup reason' | head -25

diagnostics.title: Kernel wakelocks
diagnostics.command: dumpsys batterystats | grep -E '^  Kernel Wake lock' | head -25

diagnostics.title: App wakelocks
diagnostics.command: dumpsys batterystats | grep -E '^  Wake lock ' | head -25

diagnostics.title: Wi-Fi multicast lock holders
diagnostics.command: dumpsys wifi | grep -E -A6 'Multicast Locks held|Wlan Wake Reasons'

diagnostics.title: Scanning settings
diagnostics.command: for k in wifi_scan_always_enabled ble_scan_always_enabled adaptive_battery_management_enabled low_power; do echo $k=$(settings get global $k); done
